definitions.explanation: An established practice or guideline that should be followed.
The state of something being decided or settled.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{決|き}まりを{守|まも}りなさい。

notes:
{決|き}まり is a noun meaning rule or settlement. It comes from the verb {決|き}まる (to be decided).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {決|き}まりを{守|まも}る (to follow rules)
- {決|き}まりが{悪|わる}い (to feel embarrassed/awkward)
- {決|き}まり{文句|もんく} (set phrase, cliché)

IDIOM:
- {決|き}まりが{悪|わる}い: feeling of embarrassment or awkwardness
- Example: {遅刻|ちこく}して{決|き}まりが{悪|わる}かった (I felt embarrassed for being late)

RELATED VERB:
- {決|き}まる (to be decided)
- {決|き}める (to decide)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ルール (rule - loanword)
- {規則|きそく} (regulation - more formal)
